decision.what: A record refresh creates a new dated .tex copy (afc_hours_record_YYYY-MM-DD.tex); the previously approved revision stays untouched as the historical record.
decision.why: The filename carries the as-at date, and an approved compiled document should never mutate after approval — a new date is a new artefact.

All four are derived from web_data.json and checked by the re-check script.
decision.why: User request: make the pattern visible as arithmetic. The percentages are derivable from the public data file, so they add transparency without adding anything new to the public record.
